invariants.IdempotencyRetention: A command result replays for 72 hours, then returns IDEMPOTENCY_EXPIRED.
invariants.Money: minorUnits is an integer and currency is an uppercase ISO 4217 code.
invariants.OfflineCommandEnvelope: sequence is positive and fingerprint is a SHA-256 hexadecimal value.
invariants.PaymentAmbiguity: When status is unknown, queryOnly must be true and canRetryAsNew must be false.
